snippet.title: Looters - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Looters is a couch co-op goblin heist for 2 players. Sneak, stack, and steal your way through a guarded manor packed with enemies, secrets, and loot. Take everything… and get out alive.

You can play Looters' final update for FREE now on Steam, featuring a brand new level, lootables, interactibles and much more. Check it out now! 

A huge thanks to everyone that has followed our journey and supported us throughout it all. Keep looting, heisters!
